The ML-DSA-65 public key is NOT carried here: it is pinned in the protocol configuration for the role (1,974-byte SPKI DER) and the engine verifies against the pinned key. Inlining both pinned keys would push the envelope past the 16,384-byte frame bound (about 22.5 KB), so the key stays pinned, not transmitted.

author: Samuel J. Kott
description: Envelope for a pair-binding state transition, verified by the Numina pair-binding Raft engine (src/numina-pair-binding-raft.js). v1.2.0: strict predecessor hash-chaining — raftContext.prevEntryHash is the SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of the immediately preceding committed log entry, and the genesis (first) entry's predecessor is the all-zero 64-hex-character hash ('00' repeated 32 times). The engine enforces it after index monotonicity and before hybrid signature verification (PREV_ENTRY_HASH_MISMATCH); the check uses the stored digest of the last committed entry, never a caller-supplied previous digest. v1.1.0: each attestation carries EITHER the legacy hybridSignature (NPQ1 bundle hex or record) OR a multi-algorithm signatures array with one Ed25519 entry and one ML-DSA-65 entry. BOTH parts must verify over the same RFC 8785 canonical bytes against PINNED keys taken from the engine's protocol configuration, never from the document itself. An unprovisioned ML-DSA-65 key fails closed. The ML-DSA-65 public key is pinned, not carried in the array entry: inlining both 1,974-byte SPKI keys would push the envelope to about 22.5 KB, past the frame bound. Node identity is cryptographically bound: raftContext.originNodeId / counterpartyNodeId sit inside the signed bytes, each attestation's nodeId must equal the signed node id for its role, the two node ids must be distinct, and leaderId must be one of the two node ids. Transport frame bound: the canonical serialized envelope must fit in a 16,384-byte (16 KiB) frame; larger envelopes are rejected so post-quantum signatures and keys are never truncated. The authorship block is a payload assertion, not a cryptographic proof of ownership. The engine is single-node validation plus an append-only log: not full Raft (no leader election, no log replication, no persistence), not BFT, no append-entries RPC layer, and no heartbeat protocol — leader election, RPC transport, and heartbeat scaling are design requirements for the multi-node build, not properties of this engine. The consensus path uses no RSA anywhere.

counterpartyNodeId.description: Node id bound to the counterparty (Guardian) key; inside the signed bytes.

leaderId.description: Must equal originNodeId or counterpartyNodeId: the leader is one of the two bound nodes.

originNodeId.description: Node id bound to the origin (Authority) key; inside the signed bytes.

prevEntryHash.description: SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of the immediately preceding committed log entry's unsigned envelope. The genesis (first) entry's predecessor is the all-zero 64-hex-character hash ('00' repeated 32 times). Must equal the digest stored for the last committed entry, or the all-zero hash when the log is empty.
